$:set -euo pipefail
gh auth setup-git
git fetch origin main -q
git reset --hard origin/main -q
test -f AGENTS.md
grep -q 'DISCOVERY-04' AGENTS.md
gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/issues/comments/6747425919 --jq .body > /tmp/accepted-scope-source.json
node <<'NODE'
const fs=require('fs'); const v=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/accepted-scope-source.json','utf8'));
if(v.runOn!=='$'||v.forWhom!=='GPT6_0000000227_scope_accept_publish-Terminals')throw Error('Source identity mismatch');
if(!v.whatPrompt.includes('git push origin HEAD:main'))throw Error('Expected publication instruction missing');
const command=v.whatPrompt.replace('git push origin HEAD:main','git fetch origin main -q && git rebase origin/main && git push origin HEAD:main');
fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/scope-accepted-replay.sh',command);
NODE
bash -e -o pipefail /tmp/scope-accepted-replay.sh
printf 'REMOTE_COMMIT '; git rev-parse HEAD
printf '\nWORKTREE\n'; git status --short
